findings.summary: 200+ due rows waiting on a not-live business or a location without sms_number filled every send batch; live tenants' requests went stale.
SMS refused with Twilio 21610 (recipient opted out at the provider) fell back to email and recorded no opt-out.

findings.classification: interaction (#7 fallback, #9 adapter, #12 made email real)
findings.spec: FR-6 one channel per request, never both
findings.summary: Any SMS exception, incl. a timeout after Twilio took the text, fell back to email.
A request skipped as duplicate is never re-evaluated when the request it duplicated later fails or goes stale; that customer is never asked.
findings.reason: needs a rule for re-opening duplicate skips (design decision)

findings.summary: An invalid locations.timezone throws RangeError and stops scheduling for every tenant.
findings.reason: complete fix is IANA validation when FR-1 creates locations (not built)

findings.spec: Integration principles: every outside call is retried with backoff
findings.summary: TwilioSms.send never retried; now retries 429/503 (no retry for ambiguous outcomes: no idempotency key).

findings.spec: Flow 2 step 4 / FR-8 one confirmation within 5 minutes
findings.summary: A transient Twilio error lost the opt-out confirmation. Fixed for 429/503; a timeout still loses it (needs a confirmation outbox/job queue).
Bare STOP without Advanced Opt-Out: Twilio refuses our confirmation with 21610 and the webhook returned 500; now counted as Twilio's confirmation.

findings.spec: AI reply generation, Flags: no one-tap Approve for held drafts
findings.summary: Saving a held draft's pre-filled edit form unchanged approved it without the Approve anyway confirmation.
/inbox?done=constructor|toString|__proto__ threw (500).

findings.classification: interaction (#7 state machine, #12 short retry budget)
findings.spec: Reliability: jobs run from a queue with retries and backoff
findings.summary: A Resend outage longer than ~1.5 s marks the email failed for good; nothing re-queues failed rows.
findings.reason: needs the job queue/scheduler (FR-5 partial: no scheduler)

findings.spec: none direct (Resend contract, docs not reachable from this environment)
findings.summary: Retry-After over 10 s is capped and retried early; part of F-12-2's design.
An email whose every attempt timed out may have been delivered but is recorded failed and does not count for the 90-day rule.

findings.spec: FR-12; Integrations AI model: drafting waits for the next run
findings.summary: Outages and config errors (incl. anthropic without key) counted toward the 3-failure limit and abandoned reviews for good.

findings.spec: Quality checks: no URL, no phone other than approved facts
findings.summary: Post-check missed 7-digit numbers and domains outside a short TLD list.
Sentences ending in '!)' or an ellipsis were not counted.
One-pass tag stripping let nested tags rebuild '</review>'.
429 without retry-after reported 0 s instead of unknown.
SPEC edit made the 30-review model comparison conditional ('if quality falls short').
SPEC edit dropped the 'template reply for positive reviews' AI fallback.
Implementation status marks FR-12 Implemented although no scheduler runs it; FR-22 is Partial for the same gap.
The PR recorded the AI provider decision (2026-11-23) itself; confirm against Notion.
